name: Tryout
why: Reads any color's On Recruit off the shop without buying it; a clean, deep twist on the shop.

name: Gather
why: The color's plain fuel anchor; the recruit bonus nudges red's theme but nobody else notices.

name: Walk-In
why: Free blind member plus a gift to every rival; fast, exciting, the one allowed pile draw.

name: Promote
why: Trade up into a rival's member; a real target call and a sting the victim gets something back from.

name: Demote
why: Same move as Promote trading down; rarely wanted and reads as a sibling copy.

name: Initiation
why: A free member up to 8 in round III; a big plain burst any seat can grab.

name: Body Snatchers
why: Round Start swap at equal cost hits rivals mildly and ties to Loyalists, Foster Parents and the red contest.

name: Volunteer
why: Cheap red body worth 1; does its filler job but nothing happens when you get it.

name: Mentor & Protégés
why: Three bodies plus a free cheapest member; a satisfying red chain at a stiff price.

name: Proselytizers
why: A follower on every recruit; steady red engine, invisible to rivals.

name: Mob
why: Round End payout for leading red members; strong and clear but rewards whoever is already ahead, and hard to move at 12.

name: Recruiter
why: +1 red per recruit at cost 6 is too small to feel or matter.

name: Patriarch
why: Generic member-count scorer; works the same in any cult.

name: Foster Parents
why: Pays on every member that arrives from a rival; links Promote, Poach, Body Snatchers and Double Agent.

name: Deprogrammers
why: 3 cost for 4 bodies is must-buy; the follower sting is a small extra.

name: Panel
why: A free promote or demote on arrival; strong red chain, but the terms need a rules lookup.

name: Loyalists
why: A visible block against every swap; the table's answer to red and anarchy.

name: Clerk
why: Round Start +1 red at cost 5; forgettable and never the right pick.

name: Sleep In
why: Big purple plus a claim on Went Last that rivals can take back; the token takes a read.

name: Hold Up
why: Skip whoever is next, even you; a cheap sting with timing and Gossip, Early Birds ties.

name: Right Away
why: Two turns in a row, small gain; elegant but a modest payoff.

name: Last Call
why: Followers per minion left and the token; a real hold-or-go call, wordy.

name: Crunch Time
why: Three turns in a row from few words; bends the snake hard.

name: Overtime
why: +1 minion is a whole extra turn and buy in round III; the minion rules need a lookup.

name: Courier
why: Every in-a-row turn pays a rainbow; ties to snake ends, Right Away and Crunch Time.

name: Night Watch
why: Pays when rivals grab the token; narrow and depends on others using Sleep In or Last Call.

name: Bell Ringer
hardFail: Needs tracking a table can't do: whether a placement came before a skip.
why: Unreadable condition stack for +1 purple; a table could not track it.

name: Night Owls
why: An extra placed minion from round II that likely wins Went Last; strong and clear.

name: Early Birds
why: A cheap shield against skips; a clean block, no engine.

name: Bouncers
why: Two rivals skipped on arrival; a visible sting that feeds Gossip.

name: Gossip
why: Pays on skips, including Goes Last passes a new player won't expect.

name: Timekeeper
why: Generic count-your-color scorer, same as Snobs and Old Money.

name: Closer
why: Last minion of the round pays 4 purple; a race with the Went Last contest.

name: Hot Streak
why: Once-per-game cash-in after a run of turns; a timing play, though counting the run takes care.

name: Shift Crew
why: Four bodies worth 4 for 4; must-buy with no purple idea.

name: Toast
why: Big silver that gifts every rival; simple and scales.

name: Polish
why: Silver to any colors; useful converter, nobody else feels it.

name: Party Gifts
why: Six followers for handing out three silver; who you feed in the silver contest is a real call.

name: Potluck
hardFail: Turn flow: each rival chooses what to give during your turn.
why: Rivals pick a resource to hand over on your turn; small and slow.

name: Sweet Nothings
why: Turns your silver into double any while gifting; real spend-or-hold, wording a bit loose.

name: Largesse
why: Up to 10 followers for 10 silver that may hand a rival the silver contest; a great round III call.

name: Godparent
why: Give a member away for its cost in followers; pairs with Old Maid and Martyrs.

name: Hostesses
why: Silver to every rival each round for followers; a steady gift engine.

name: Caterer
why: Pays on every gift, but what counts as gifted needs a ruling.

name: Toastmaster
why: +1 follower per Silver space; plain and forgettable.

name: Debutantes
why: Double your silver once; a big hoarder moment with a timing call.

name: Smooth Talkers
why: Silver pays for anything; strong but a costly hoard-color rule that ignores rivals.

name: Philanthropist
why: A smaller Largesse on arrival; repeats the spaces.

name: Guest of Honor
why: Hand off a cheap member for 4 followers each Silver space; pairs with Old Maid and filler.

name: Creditor
why: Take 2 followers from a chosen rival who gets 3 silver; a fair, aimed trade each round.

name: Debt Collectors
why: Once-per-game take from every rival; a theft that reads as another color's job.

name: High Society
why: Pays when rivals take Silver spaces; makes the gift spaces a little tense.

name: Envy
hardFail: Relies on a rival having more resources than you.
why: Catch-up silver tied to a rival out-holding you; banned shape.

name: Harvest
why: The plain anchor, choosing colors so it feeds sets.

name: Leaders' Tax
why: Pays by where rivals sit; reads the board but small.

name: New Blood
why: Followers for a new color recruit; same recruit-bonus shape as three other colors.

name: Housewarming
why: A free member of a new color up to 5; strong, clear, works with no members.

name: Melting Pot
why: Pays for variety you built; a quiet engine, nobody else feels it.

name: Makeover
why: Rearrange everything in round III to finish sets and swing held-color contests.

name: Gardeners
why: Fills missing colors every round for 3; cheap, strong, helps the poor.

name: Customs Officer
why: Pays only when rivals touch your resources; +1 yellow rarely felt.

name: Tourist
why: Followers per color held each round; a steady variety scorer.

name: Harmonist
why: Game End pays for full sets the contest already rewards; flat.

name: Dyer
why: Tourist's shape paying yellow; a sibling repeat.

name: Meddler
why: Change every rival's resources on arrival; aimed at sets and contests, wording a bit loose.

name: Drifters
why: Pick a color to count as; feeds red and blue contests and variety cards, needs a marker.

name: Big Tent
why: Rewards one member per color; a real plan, quiet at the table.

name: Caravan
why: A third per-color-held income at 9; rewards the already broad cult.

name: Jack-of-All-Trades
why: Yellow fills set gaps; clean, small.

name: Savings
why: Fuel plus a bury before buying; a small deny.

name: Out of Style
why: Clear a whole color from the shop; a sharp deny rivals feel.

name: Peek
why: Stack the pile and buy from it; strong control, only the taker remembers the order.

name: Recruit Twice
why: Two buys in one turn; simple and big.

name: Bury
why: One more way to bury a shop member; repeats Savings.

name: Spree
why: Three buys in round III; a burst any seat can grab.

name: Hawker
hardFail: Turn flow: rivals each choose to buy during your turn.
why: An auction with an extra cost rule; wordy and asks rivals to act on your turn.

name: Patroness
why: Pays on every bury, including the between-round row refresh a reader won't see coming.

name: Snobs
why: Generic count-your-color scorer.

name: Window Shopper
why: Buries two each round for their colors; a deny with income.

name: Shopaholics
why: Two buys every turn; a huge engine that rewards the leader.

name: Window Dressers
why: Cheap three bodies with a row-clear; must-buy filler.

name: Doormen
why: Swap a rival's member for a shop member under a cost rule; too many parts to read cold.

name: Regular
why: Blue for buying followers; off theme and tiny.

name: Trendsetters
why: Bury on every recruit; cheap three bodies that feed Patroness.

name: Critic
why: Pays when rivals buy blue members; rarely fires and never felt.

name: Scavenger
hardFail: Turn flow: asks its owner to choose during a rival's turn.
why: Grab what rivals bury, but the choice comes on their turn.

name: Help Yourself
why: Steal and split as you like; aimed, scaling, answered by Lie Low and Bodyguards.

name: Stash
why: Same text as Gather and Allowance; no magenta idea.

name: Lie Low
why: Small steal plus a round of safety; a block players see.

name: Heist
why: Take 3 followers outright; clear sting on the leader.

name: Shake Down
hardFail: Turn flow: the victim chooses their member during your turn.
why: The victim picks their own punishment; feels too bad.

name: Poach
why: Take any rival's member in round III; the big ending swing.

name: Cutpurse
why: A steady skim off the richest; cheap, no aim.

name: Accomplice
why: A one-shot steal 3; a Help Yourself repeat on a card.

name: Grifter
why: Steals scale with members at cost 8; weak and leader-leaning.

name: Second-Story Man
why: Steal before contests are scored; a sharp, timed swing.

name: Desperado
why: Bigger steals while trailing; real catch-up.

name: Extortionist
why: Cutpurse doubled at 8; a sibling repeat.

name: Bodyguards
why: Total theft immunity; a clear block that switches off an answer.

name: Double Agent
why: Pay 8 to trade itself for any rival's member; a clever swap.

name: Kidnapper
why: Takes members every round before III; the victim feels robbed.

name: Shoplifter
why: A steal on every recruit; a quiet engine.

name: Fence
why: Pays when robbed; a mild deterrent.

name: Allowance
why: Same text as Gather and Stash; no white idea.

name: Splurge
why: Followers for what you spend; round III wording unclear.

name: Exchange
why: Resources to followers at a better rate; small.

name: Farewell
why: Cast out a member for its cost in followers; pairs with Martyrs.

name: Estate Sale
why: Farewell paying white; a sibling repeat.

name: Cash In
why: Every white to followers in round III; a clean cash-out.

name: Recluse
why: Pays for being small against the member contest; a real anti-plan.

name: Landlord
why: Steady white income; plain.

name: Heiresses
why: Once-per-game white per member at 9; weak and leader-leaning.

name: Brokers
why: +1 on White follower gains; cheap three bodies.

name: Misers
why: Game End for held white; plain.

name: Raiders
why: Take 4 followers for 2 white; aimed and catch-up.

name: Cashier
why: Cash In on a card; strong, repeats the space.

name: Money Changers
why: White on every follower buy; steady, unseen.

name: Martyrs
why: Pays when taken; makes every swap and steal a decision.

name: Old Money
why: Generic count-your-color scorer.

name: Hoarder
why: Turn all to white for Cash In; a combo piece, dead alone.

name: Build Up
why: Green's plain anchor.

name: Echo
why: Copy the previous action; elegant and better as the round grows.

name: Reprise
why: Copy your own minion's action; strong and clear.

name: Sample
why: Borrow a rival's On Recruit; deep but needs a read.

name: Cover
why: Copy an empty action; plays off the open rings.

name: Greatest Hits
why: Every On Recruit again in round III; a big payoff for building.

name: Busker
why: Steady green income; plain.

name: Impersonator
why: Borrow a rival's ability each round; deep, needs a marker.

name: Impressionist
why: +1 per copy anyone makes; small.

name: Wallflower
why: Doubles copied gains at 10; strong for the copier, leader-leaning.

name: Fan Club
why: Copy the leader's action on arrival; catch-up with three bodies.

name: Roadie
why: Income per green member; a small engine.

name: Stunt Double
why: Do your action again on arrival; clean.

name: Tribute Band
why: Do every action a rival took once; a huge moment at 14.

name: Doppelganger
why: Become a copy of your best member; clean and deep.

name: Agents
why: Blocks copying of your actions; a clear defense.

name: Encore
why: Double the next On Recruit; a timed combo.

name: Party Crasher
why: Join a taken space once; bends the blocking rule.

name: Alchemists
why: Everything pays as any; three bodies at 5, strong.

name: Extra Hand
why: One extra minion once; plain power.

name: Line Cutters
why: Go first every round for 2; must-buy that undoes the catch-up order.

name: Old Maid
why: A hot potato for Godparent and Guest of Honor; dead to recruit yourself.

name: Dabblers
why: Two wild bodies; strong but what wild counts for takes rulings.

name: Anarchist
why: Swap any two members every round; fun for its owner, rough on victims.

name: Spoilsport
why: Cancel a contest you don't lead; a sharp catch-up tool.

name: Con Men
why: Steal 5 on arrival; big, plain.

name: Sore Loser
why: Steal from the top contest winner when you win none; real catch-up.
